title: ClinicalAIFeatureFlagConfig
description: Strict JSON schema for Clinical AI feature flag and operating mode configuration.

operating_mode.description: System-wide operating mode. Defaults to LEGACY_ONLY in production.

official_retrieval_enabled.description: Controls official glossary and method document node retrieval.

gate_b_reasoning_enabled.description: Controls GraphRAG multi-hop traversal and entity linking.

gate_c_novelty_enabled.description: Controls Gate C novelty discovery and cross-domain therapeutic hypothesis generation.

gate_d_formatting_enabled.description: Controls Gate D clinical consultation response formatting and advisory output structuring.

audit_logging_enabled.description: Controls immutable audit trail logging across all pipeline steps.

shadow_comparison_enabled.description: Controls dual-execution shadow testing mode for latency and diff analysis.

therapist_pilot_access_enabled.description: Master gate for enabling internal therapist pilot user access via RBAC.

metadata.description: Governance and audit tracking metadata for configuration deployments.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of configuration change.

updated_by.description: Email or identity of authorizer making the configuration change.

sign_off_reference.description: Reference ticket or audit sign-off ID (e.g. AUDIT-GATE-D-20260722).
